name: portfolio-booking-cards
title: Booking Cards
description: Contact cards with Cal.com scheduling embeds.
docs: Imported from the portfolio project. Customize personal copy, links, social profiles, booking URLs, and data before use. Requires React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn theme variables. Files install under your components alias in lazy-ui/, with their relative imports preserved. Import the installed lazy-ui/styles/portfolio.css in your global stylesheet. For Base UI animation utilities, also import shadcn/tailwind.css. Replace the Cal.com booking links and allow its embed in your CSP.
